Note

Implementation order

  1. Index saved content. Store task IDs, titles and plain note text. Rebuild the index when its schema changes.
  2. Return stable results. Match titles before notes. Use the task ID to resolve equal scores.
  3. Connect the UI. Keep the query in the URL. Enter opens the selected task; Escape returns to the board.
  4. Verify the flow. Check empty queries, renamed tasks, deleted projects and keyboard access.
Decision needed

Include archived projects by default, or add an “Include archived” filter? Start with active projects if older results make the list hard to scan.
